assertion: An event exists, described as "Magnitude 7.3 earthquake in southern Mexico".
judge_quote: A powerful magnitude 7.3 earthquake struck off the coast of southern Mexico on Friday
evidence_cited: A powerful magnitude 7.3 earthquake struck off the coast of southern Mexico on Friday, triggering a tsunami warning for parts of the Pacific.

The quake, which struck near the fishing town of Puerto Madero in Mexico at 08:49 local time (14:49 GMT) on Friday, had a depth of 15.2 km (9 miles), according to the United States Geological Survey (USGS).

assertion: An event exists, described as "Tsunami warning issued for Mexico and Guatemala".
judge_quote: The US Tsunami Warning System had warned of possible " hazardous tsunami waves" along the nearby coasts of Mexico and Guatemala
evidence_cited: The US Tsunami Warning System had warned of possible 'hazardous tsunami waves' along the nearby coasts of Mexico and Guatemala.

The U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), which operates the tsunami warning center, forecast waves of less than 0.3m above tide level along the coasts of El Salvador, Colombia, Costa Rice, Ecuador, Nicaragua, Panama, Peru and Honduras.

assertion: A claim exists, described as "Admiral Morales states no serious impact from earthquake".
judge_quote: Mexico's navy secretary Admiral Raymundo Morales told a press conference that there was "no serious impact"
evidence_cited: Mexico's navy secretary Admiral Raymundo Morales told a press conference that there was 'no serious impact', but that people were being advised to stay away from beaches.
